en: Legends tell of acts so unspeakable they could not be chronicled in the record of the murals—acts such as the crimes of the scavengers who pillaged blessed artifacts from the holy tombs.
Summons a sphere that will ricochet off of surfaces for a time before vanishing.
One of many created by the Mutilants, this relic can harness the energy of the wearer's pain and reshape it into vile, corporeal form.
On impact, the Canister creates a bubble that slows down time. More powerful beings remain unaffected.
This otherwordly contraption is unlike any of the wonders created by the artificers of the Gray City. Perhaps whoever engineered it applied it as a tool of preservation... or punishment.
Releases a bi-directional wave of spikes that travels along the ground, damaging anything it touches.
This bulbous mass of flesh, sinew, and bone appears ready to burst, undulating and squirming in response to physical stimuli.
Summons a blade to perform an arcing swing.
Orbs materialize and orbit around the summoner, damaging anything they touch.
The countless stone chimes lining the streets of the Gray City still beckon its former inhabitants.
Releases a lingering cloud that damages foes until dissipating.
Putridity is the breeding ground of life unseen, and the alchemists pursued such studies further than any other. Strange and purposeless, it takes on new forms within the barren hives of the Gardens.
Summons an arcing projectile that can be struck to send it flying horizontally.
As the firmament ruptured, pieces of the shattered sky showered the land, vibrating with latent energy.
Releases an explosive that sticks to surfaces, detonating after a brief duration.
Irrespective of size, no creature remained untouched by the corruption that arose within the Gardens.
Releases a bouncing explosive, lighting enemies on fire.
It is not without reason that some of the alchemists' experiments were banished from the Gardens' plateaus.
Manifests an orb of Voidal energy that slowly travels forward.
The anomalies observed within the Obsidian tower were long believed to be isolated phenomena, until a stable coalescence of Voidal energy breached the black stone.
Creates a wall that lights enemies on fire.
Scarce attempts were made to harness the power of the crimson Light, all with intensely volatile results.
DEBUG - This item won't show in the inventory later.
Amalgamations of stone and metal, these intricately artificed pieces stem from the lost technology of the First Civilization. They appear to originally have been part of a larger whole.
Gazing into the Orb, its inside appears impossibly deep. Swirling patterns of stars hypnotically dance within, as if beckoning the onlooker to join. Time begins to feel almost inconsequential.
The hypnotic spiral of stars within the Mysterious Orb has settled, its surface having turned opaque and dull upon the touch of the Vizier. You still feel her presence within.
After being tampered with, the hypnotic spiral of stars within the Mysterious Orb has settled, its surface now opaque and dull.
An engorged cyst, eager to poison anything it comes into contact with.

This marvel of ancient ingenuity provides an intense direct psychic connection to the gods. Once used in ritual worship, it has also functioned as a tool to punish and subdue. Present it to Void Priest So-Venat to gain an additional Void Charge.
The processed form of the metal of the gods, ready to be shaped into something useful.
The eternal, living blood of the Progenitor gods. Highly valued for its divine nature, and consumed by some in efforts to commune with them.
An inert piece of a long-forgotten artifact, its Voidal energies long vanished. Still, it holds value to artificers and peddlers.
Created to hold replenishing vitae in its purest form, the Receptacle currently lies dormant. Present it to Void Priest Namun to gain additional Healing Salt.
First discovered scattered across the world during the First Emergence, these scarce phenomena are believed by some to be what remains of the ruptured souls of the Progenitor gods.
Mined from the great cluster of ore veins sprouting from the depths beneath the Gray City. Its feint psychic properties and mesmerizing appearance once treasured by the First Civilization.
Encrypted writings that can be consumed to unseal Vaults.
An everliving, writhing mass of godlike Flesh. Its eternally regenerative properties are a thing witnessed by few, yet sought by many, be it for purposes of worship, knowledge, or longevity.
Allows for the activation of the Gray City's elaborate network of Void Gates, granting instant translocation between discovered Gates.
Unliving followers who congregate within the Shrine of the Gray Pyramid, seeking to restore its former glory. Idle hands may be put to work excavating its inner chambers.
What appears to be the contorted Remains of a long-dead member of the crew. No resemblance of a person remains.
Once enough Shards have been collected, maximum Health is increased.
Ashes scraped from the bottom of fermentation vessels scattered across the Lost Gardens.
What remains of the Astronomer's intricate helmet.
Maddening recounts of places, events, and beings from the past, present, and future. Of interest only to ignorant truthseekers—or those of unsound mind.
An all-encompassing vision of the First Civilization, reflected in overbearing detail.
The Key pulses with warmth, aligning itself in the direction of the Gray Pyramid.
The Key radiates an unnatural chill, aligning itself in the direction of the Gray Pyramid.
The Key reverberates with unseen energy, aligning itself in the direction of the Gray Pyramid.
The petroglyphs speak of a great construct once raised within these halls. Perhaps it still remains.
The membrane between the planes seems particularly thin in this region. Perhaps one of the Grand Vizier's mirrors survived the fall.
Yes... This must be it. We have reached the walls of the Shunned Library, sealed by the apostates as the city fell.
None remember what lies within the Inner Sanctum, for it was reserved only for a select few... until now.
Something remains on the other side of this wall. Can you hear its whispers?
These passages have crumbled like our once great city. We must press on.
The pathways of the Gray Pyramid run deep. We must breathe air into them once more.
We sense a great congregation of Voidal energy within this lower chamber.
Someone went to great lengths to seal this area of the Gray Pyramid. What secrets could such a place hold?
